title: Hot Wheels Model Car Kits
summary: A Model Car Kit is a toy car, usually in 1:32, 1:25 & 1:24 scale that needs to be assembled, glued, painted, and put together to have a finished custom car. Hot Wheels has released many kits for many years under different Model Kit companies such as AMT, Polar Lights, Snaps, Revell, and many more listed below.

title: SpinShotz
summary: 200px|rightSpinShotz was a very short-lived series of plastic spinning-top toys produced exclusively in 2013. They were packaged in pairs and are believed to have been Mattel’s answer to TakaraTomy’s Beyblade series. SpinShotz is thought to have been a major commercial failure for the Hot Wheels brand, with the product line beginning and ending in 2013 and never returning.
